question.text: SEBI's __________ allows market participants to test their new products and solutions offline, in isolation from the live market, whereas the Regulatory Sandbox involves live testing with a limited set of real customers.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, the Innovation Sandbox allows market participants to test proposed solutions offline, in isolation from the live market. The Regulatory Sandbox, in contrast, involves live testing with a limited set of real customers. The Trap: The most common confusion is between the Innovation Sandbox and the Regulatory Sandbox. The distinguishing feature is offline/in-isolation testing versus live/limited-customer testing. Testing Sandbox and Virtual Market Sandbox are not terms used by the workbook. Note: The workbook pages describe the offline-isolated versus live-limited-customer distinction; they do not state that the Innovation Sandbox specifically requires no regulatory approvals.
